title: Nano Banana Infographic Creator Input Schema
description: Input specification for creating professional infographics, slide illustrations, data charts, and visual assets optimized for Google Nano Banana 2/Pro (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image / Gemini 3 Pro Image)

description.title: 1. Content Description
description.description: Describe the infographic, slide illustration, or chart you want to create. Can be in Thai or English — the AI will transform it into an optimized Nano Banana prompt.
examples: Create a minimal slide background for a business growth presentation
Bar chart showing quarterly revenue Q1-Q4 2026
5-step design thinking infographic in cartoon style with Thai labels
Photorealistic executive slide with 3 KPI metrics
Technology icon set for presentation slides
สร้างอินโฟกราฟิกสถิติอินเทอร์เน็ตประเทศไทย

contentType.title: 2. Content Type
contentType.description: Type of visual content to generate. Determines layout, style approach, and model selection.

enumDescriptions.slide_illustration: Slide background/key visual — minimal, modern, with negative space for text
enumDescriptions.chart_bar: Bar chart — vertical/horizontal bars for comparisons
enumDescriptions.chart_line: Line chart — trends, time series, growth curves
enumDescriptions.chart_pie: Pie/donut chart — proportions, distributions, market share
enumDescriptions.chart_mixed: Mixed chart — combination of bar, line, and area charts
enumDescriptions.photorealistic_slide: Photorealistic slide — studio photo background with data overlay
enumDescriptions.asset_header: Header asset — banner/strip component for slides
enumDescriptions.asset_icons: Icon set — consistent line/flat icons for slides
enumDescriptions.process_flow: Process flow — workflow steps, decision trees

aspectRatio.title: 3. Aspect Ratio
aspectRatio.description: Image aspect ratio. 16:9 is standard for presentations. Extreme ratios (4:1, 8:1) only available on Nano Banana 2.

resolution.title: 4. Resolution
resolution.description: Output image resolution. Higher = better quality but slower generation. 4K recommended for print or large displays.

enumDescriptions.4k: 4K — Ultra quality for print/large display, slowest

style.title: 5. Visual Style
style.description: Overall visual design approach that determines colors, shapes, and composition.

enumDescriptions.minimal_modern: Clean, geometric, negative space — Corporate slides, modern presentations
enumDescriptions.flat_corporate: Professional flat design — Business reports, formal presentations
enumDescriptions.cartoon_friendly: Colorful cartoon illustrations — Education, training, kids content
enumDescriptions.isometric: 3D isometric perspective — Tech diagrams, process flows
enumDescriptions.photorealistic: Studio photography style — Pitch decks, executive reports
enumDescriptions.futuristic_clean: Dark background, neon accents — Tech, AI, innovation
enumDescriptions.hand_drawn: Sketchy, organic lines — Workshops, brainstorming, creative
enumDescriptions.gradient_abstract: Bold gradients, abstract shapes — Trendy, modern, social media

model.title: 6. Model Selection
model.description: Which Nano Banana model to use. Auto will select based on content type.

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select — Flash for speed, Pro for text/data fidelity
enumDescriptions.google-banana-2: Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) — Fast, good for bulk/simple
enumDescriptions.google-nano-banana-pro: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) — Best quality, text fidelity, data viz

outputFormat.title: 7. Output Format
outputFormat.description: Image file format. PNG for text/charts (lossless), JPEG for photos (smaller), WebP for web.

enumDescriptions.png: PNG — Lossless, best for text, charts, icons (Recommended)
enumDescriptions.jpeg: JPEG — Compressed, best for photorealistic images
enumDescriptions.webp: WebP — Modern web format, smaller file size

textLanguage.title: 8. Text Language in Image
textLanguage.description: Language of text that appears IN the generated image (titles, labels, captions).

enumDescriptions.en: English only — Best text rendering quality
enumDescriptions.th: Thai only — Requires Pro model for best results
enumDescriptions.both: Both Thai and English — Bilingual labels

useGoogleSearch.title: 9. Use Google Search (Real-time Data)
useGoogleSearch.description: Enable Google Search grounding to fetch current, factual data for charts and infographics. Best for statistics, market data, and trends.

searchQuery.title: 10. Search Query (Optional)
searchQuery.description: Specific data query for Google Search grounding. Leave empty for auto-generated queries from description.
examples: Top 5 social media platforms usage Thailand 2026
Southeast Asia e-commerce market size comparison 2026

chartData.title: 11. Chart Data (Optional)
chartData.description: Pre-defined data for charts. Format: 'Label1=Value1, Label2=Value2' or leave empty for Google Search data.

colorScheme.title: 12. Color Scheme
colorScheme.description: Color palette preference for the infographic.

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on content type and style
enumDescriptions.green_nature: Green palette — Health, nature, growth, sustainability
enumDescriptions.red_energy: Red palette — Urgency, energy, sales, performance
enumDescriptions.brand_custom: Custom brand colors — Specify in description

numImages.title: 13. Number of Images
numImages.description: Number of image variations to generate.

negativeElements.title: 14. Elements to Avoid (Optional)
negativeElements.description: List elements to avoid in the generated image.
